title: High-Usage Site Add-On to the Small Business Electricity Supply Multi-Site Credit
content:
**Programme term.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply multi-site credit, the credited cycle's billed kWh are read from the agreement's latest energy line, the line of its latest billed cycle. A credited cycle whose energy line billed 12000 kWh or more adds 4.00 dollars; a credited cycle that billed at least 8000 but fewer than 12000 kWh adds 2.00 dollars; a credited cycle that billed fewer than 8000 kWh adds nothing.

## Add-on by billed kWh

| kWh billed on the credited cycle's energy line | Site load add-on |
|---|---|
| 12000 or more | 4.00 USD |
| 8000 to 11999 | 2.00 USD |
| fewer than 8000 | none |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical cycles)

| kWh billed | Add-on |
|---|---|
| 7999 | none |
| 8000 | 2.00 USD |
| 11999 | 2.00 USD |
| 12000 | 4.00 USD |

## Which energy line is read

Only the energy line of the credited cycle counts, that is the agreement's latest billed cycle. A hypothetical agreement whose last three energy lines billed 13100, 9400 and 6900 kWh, the 6900 kWh line being the latest, takes no add-on for the cycle credited, because the latest line billed fewer than 8000 kWh.
